name: FrogIconButton
description: Compact icon-only action control with semantic variants, accessible labeling, loading support, and optional badge content.

accessibility.talkBackNotes: contentDescription is mandatory for actionable icon controls. TalkBack announces the button role, label, loading state, and disabled state while child icons remain decorative.

properties.name: icon
properties.description: The visual icon content. Should be decorative from the semantics tree as the parent IconButton provides the accessible name.

properties.name: contentDescription
properties.description: Mandatory accessible description describing the action performed when activated.

properties.name: onClick
properties.description: Callback triggered when clicked by touch, keyboard, or accessibility action.

properties.name: modifier
properties.description: Layout modifier applied to the outer touch-target container.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Visual semantic variant: Filled, Tonal, Outline, or Ghost.

properties.name: size
properties.description: Dimensional scale: Small (32dp container), Medium (40dp container), or Large (48dp container).

properties.name: enabled
properties.description: Controls interaction state. When false, clicks are suppressed and visual style becomes muted.

properties.name: loading
properties.description: Replaces visible icon with a centered progress indicator while preserving container bounds. Suppresses activation.

properties.name: badge
properties.description: Optional badge overlay slot anchored at TopEnd outside the centered icon.

properties.name: colors
properties.description: Resolved container, content, and border colors across enabled and disabled states.

properties.name: shape
properties.description: Corner radius shape applied to the button container and border.

properties.name: interactionSource
properties.description: Interaction stream driving press animations and focus rings.

examples.title: Basic Action
examples.description: High-emphasis icon action with a solid container.

examples.title: Tonal Action
examples.description: Medium-emphasis icon action on a muted container.

examples.title: Outlined Action
examples.description: Medium/low-emphasis icon action with a structural border.

examples.title: Loading State
examples.description: Displays a centered progress indicator and suppresses user interaction.

examples.title: Badged Action
examples.description: Displays an unclipped overlay badge anchored at TopEnd.

examples.title: Toolbar Actions
examples.description: Multiple icon buttons composed inside an app toolbar.
